title: Bornu Empire
capsule: The Bornu Empire was the successor state founded by the Sayfawa dynasty west of Lake Chad after their expulsion from Kanem, with its capital eventually at Ngazargamu. Under rulers such as Mai Idris Alooma (late 16th century) it became a powerful Islamic state with firearms-equipped armies dominating the central Sudan. It endured, later under the al-Kanemi dynasty, until conquered by Rabih az-Zubayr in 1893 and absorbed into European colonial empires by 1894.
